note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are moving to a new benefits provider and must tell all 1,400 employees, but our last intranet announcement was read by only 35% of staff.

answers.common.decision: How to announce the change so everyone sees it; the head of people signs off the messages.
answers.common.materials: Announcements emailed from a named leader were read by 70% of staff. 420 employees work in our warehouses without company email.
answers.content-communications.brief: All employees, including warehouse staff; plain, reassuring, practical.
